description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineIpcClientMock' for the 'IMediaPipelineIpcClient' interface, used for testing media pipeline IPC client interactions in the Rialto project. It includes mock methods for various notification functions related to media playback, network state, QoS, and buffer underflow.

classes.name: MediaPipelineIpcClientMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IMediaPipelineIpcClient for testing purposes.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Mocks notification of playback state changes.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Mocks notification of network state changes.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Mocks notification for requesting media data, including source ID, frame count, request ID, and shared memory info.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Mocks notification of media position updates.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Mocks notification of buffer underflow events.
